title: Quản lý Tài nguyên và Môi trường

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic management tools used by the government, businesses, and communities in managing natural resources and the environment.
Understand the theoretical and practical foundations of managing natural resources and environmental components.
Analyze and discuss practical management activities related to natural resources and the environment.
Develop independent learning, teamwork, and self-responsibility skills.
Conduct research and prepare reports on practical management of natural resources and the environment.
Prepare and deliver group presentations on practical cases and management proposals for natural resources and the environment.
Understand the legal basis for managing natural resources and the environment.
Understand the theoretical and practical foundations of managing natural resources and environmental components.
Understand and apply community-based management models for natural resources and the environment.
Understand and apply management approaches for natural resources and the environment in businesses.
Understand and apply environmental policies and instruments for natural resource management.
